collection_method: PubMed E-utilities (eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov) ESearch+ESummary direct API access; journal filter Carbohydr Polym[ta], Journal Article type, Review type excluded; supplemented with a targeted ESearch for soybean protein isolate / paper coating keywords to ensure focus-keyword coverage.
